tasks.title: Write an Email
tasks.instruction: Write an email. In your email, do the following:
tasks.prompt: You are considering registering for a public-speaking course next semester, but you cannot find the course description online. You are unsure whether the course is at the right difficulty level for you. Write an email to Professor Nguyen, the instructor.
bullets: Explain why you are interested in the course.
Describe your previous experience with public speaking and ask whether the course is right for you.
Request information on the course requirements.
tasks.subject: Public-speaking course
